cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Keep the treasurer's page out of the fair briefing. Our chair needs everyone's confidence today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She spent the stall money on that arch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Call it donated decoration. If the stallholders find out, they'll replace her before we open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover the shortfall, but she must sign an IOU.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Privately, after her welcome. Let them see her opening the fair, not borrowing to open it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 hides misuse to prevent replacement and A5 private IOU protects chair power; S03 is largely inserted wrapper.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 spent stall money explains shortfall; B4 cover with IOU fits A5 private signing after welcome.

relationship.evidence: B2 names fact and B4 offers real solution with accountability condition, both shaping A concealment.

heightening.evidence: B4 IOU condition causes A5 private timing after public authority display.
